crossRefs.note: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

parallels.note: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

people.name: Abishua
people.line: Son of Phinehas, grandson of Eleazar the high priest

people.name: Bukki
people.line: High priest, son of Abishua and father of Uzzi

people.name: Uzzi
people.line: High priest in the line of Eleazar

translations.web: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
translations.bsb: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
translations.kjv: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
translations.asv: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
